issues.message: Persistent world-state plaques obscure customers and shelves; replace explanatory text with icon/count/state treatments.
Multiple customer routes and labels compete visually; active customer route must be primary and inactive routes subdued.
Restock, pickup, checkout and upgrade lack distinct short feedback bundles; add causal player-visible motion feedback without blocking input.

acceptanceCriteria: No persistent black explanatory plaques overlap customers, shelves, or paths; critical states remain readable via icon, color, count, or progress.
Only the active customer route is fully emphasized; inactive routes are visually subordinate and the door→shelf→checkout order is legible within two seconds.
Restock, pickup, checkout, and upgrade each produce a distinct player-visible feedback bundle that settles within 500 ms and does not block movement.
Add focused regression tests, rebuild once, then rerun deterministic, natural-input, and perceptual QA on the exact matrix cells.
